title: notifyChange producers wired: backfill and reembed remain bare
summary: All per-request graph-mutating routes in routes/overlay.js that resolve their target workspace via targetOverlay now pass T.ws to notifyChange(). The two global-scan routes — /overlay/backfill-embeddings and /overlay/reembed — operate on state.workspace directly (no per-request T) and intentionally remain bare because they touch all workspaces, not a single targeted one. A bare notifyChange() still forces a refetch on all clients, which is correct for a global sweep.
